name: A Reproducible Synthetic Benchmark (8 Profiles, 40 Files)
description: Overview This small, purposive synthetic benchmark measures plain-text extraction from 40 PDF CVs derived from eight distinct fictional profiles: graduate, teacher, engineer and lawyer, with a different Arabic and English profile in each group. Four text layouts and one all-page image-only control per profile are processed by pypdf 6.10.0 and PyMuPDF 1.26.7, producing 80 measurement rows. With fixed normalization and reference-based metrics, Arabic text-PDF word recall ranges from 74.79% to 93.02% for pypdf and 88.19% to 91.60% for PyMuPDF. The English text PDFs return 100% word recall in these tested conditions. All 16 image-control extraction runs return zero word recall without OCR. A same-team computational repeat on the original bytes reproduced all 80 rows and raw-text hashes. The package preserves complete inputs, PDFs, HTML sources, raw outputs, code, checksums and a technical report. It is not peer reviewed, does not test commercial ATS products or the Astr production renderer, and cannot establish population failure rates or a causal language effect. The Arabic and English profiles are not translations or matched controls. Package 2.0.1 adds documentation and verification to unchanged protocol-2.0 evidence measured on 2026-10-01.
